levers.risk: CampaignMatchHost serializes applyHostIntent through runExclusive (CampaignMatchHost.ts:405-413, :456). Two CampaignHostIntent frames from one host may serialize and both commit. Concurrent HTTP SpendFunds versus a page CampaignHostIntent is the remaining in-paths candidate and will be measured; if both commit, the class is a non-claim.
